news.title: Indian Equity Markets Rally Over 1.5%: Sensex Jumps 1,109 Pts, Nifty Tops 22,500 Led by IT & FMCG
news.snippet: Indian benchmark indices recorded robust buying with Sensex gaining 1,109 points and Nifty 50 adding 358 points. IT bellwethers TCS and HCL Tech led the rally alongside domestic institutional buying support.

news.title: FII & DII Trading Activity: Domestic Institutional Buying Offsets Foreign Outflows Across NSE & BSE
news.snippet: DIIs recorded net purchases exceeding ₹3,045 crore in cash markets, providing essential liquidity counterweights against cautious global foreign institutional investor positioning ahead of CPI release.

news.title: Indian Rupee Rebounds to 95.84 as RBI Initiates Liquidity Measures Across Foreign Exchange Markets
news.snippet: The Reserve Bank of India stepped in with proactive currency stabilization measures to mitigate volatility, supporting the rupee's recovery after steady gains in Asian forex trading.

news.title: Economic Times: Indian Corporates Display Expanding Operating Cash Flows Across Tech and Banking
news.snippet: Over 2,500 listed companies on NSE and BSE showed accelerating cash from operations, signaling resilient balance sheet strength and reduced debt leverage across core manufacturing and service sectors.

news.title: BSE Sensex and Nifty Positioned Near Critical Resistance Ahead of Key Inflation and Earnings Print
news.snippet: Indian indices hovered near support levels as traders analyzed CPI trajectory and preliminary Q2 corporate earnings reports, with domestic bond yields easing slightly.

news.title: NSE Institutional Trend: FII Derivative Long-Short Ratio Shows Early Accumulation in Frontline Bluechips
news.snippet: Derivative market positioning reveals foreign portfolio investors covering index short positions, particularly in Nifty Bank and Nifty IT contracts following positive forward guidance.

news.title: Pre-Market Pulse: GIFT Nifty Signals Firm Opening; Crude Oil Moderates to Support Market Sentiment
news.snippet: Global cues remain supportive with Brent crude cooling, lending impetus to oil marketing companies and rate-sensitive banking counters on Dalal Street.

news.title: FII Inflows in Emerging Markets: India Remains Prime Destination for Long-Term Sovereign Allocations
news.snippet: Market analysts note that structural domestic mutual fund SIP inflows exceeding ₹23,000 crore monthly continue to transform Indian equity market resilience against external shocks.
